'... supply with a new 18V51/60DF GenSet that will provide more than 18 MW' (adds to existing installation of more than 64 MW). Commissioning Q1 2026. Conflicting plant/engine figures as printed.
'signed a contract with KAB Energy Holdings to supply seven 18V51/60DF engines with a total output of 120 MW' (Labuan Island); commissioning planned end 2026.
'seven 20V35/44G gas engines from Everllence with a potential output of more than 70 MW will cover the demand of the 52 MW power plant' - conflicting ratings preserved.
